01 / About

Signal in the noise.

I'm an Electronics and Communication Engineer (B.Tech, Dayananda Sagar University, 2025), currently pursuing an M.Tech in Digital Communication and Networking at REVA University, expected 2027. My work sits at the intersection of embedded hardware, signal processing, and systems that need to make fast, reliable decisions in the real world — fire detection, traffic control, telemetry.

Alongside the engineering, I run a parallel practice in photography and videography — treating a frame with the same discipline I bring to a circuit: deliberate composition, controlled light, and a story told with restraint rather than noise.

I completed a hands-on internship at Ananth Technologies Pvt. Ltd., training in the testing department for converters, power systems, and telemetry & telecommand systems — grounding my academic work in the standards of aerospace-grade engineering.
